neighbours.label: The preposition right after 'aware' or 'familiar' (aware of, familiar with)
fire: Few residents were aware of the changes to the bus schedule.
She is not familiar with the rules of cricket.
Many teenagers are unaware of how long data stays online.
The pilot was aware of the storm well before takeoff.
Are you familiar with this style of painting?
Customers should be aware of the fees before signing.
He became familiar with the city after a few months.
We were fully aware of the risks involved.
quiet: Few residents attended the meeting about the bus schedule.
She is not fond of the rules of cricket.
Many teenagers are proud of how they handle their data online.
The pilot was ready for the storm well before takeoff.
Are you pleased with this style of painting?
Customers should read the fees before signing.
He became fond of the city after a few months.
We were fully ready for the risks involved.
